soil_organic_carbon.description: Soil organic carbon (SOC) is the single strongest predictor of soil microbial diversity and water holding capacity in cultivated land.
soil_organic_carbon.reference: FAO Global Soil Partnership, Status of the World's Soil Resources (2015)

soil_ph.description: Soil pH outside 6.0-7.5 sharply reduces nutrient availability (notably phosphorus and micronutrients) and constrains which plant and microbial species can establish.
soil_ph.reference: Bardgett & van der Putten, Belowground biodiversity and ecosystem functioning, Nature (2014)

soil_moisture.description: Soil moisture regulates root zone habitat for soil fauna and directly limits vegetation cover, which is the base layer of terrestrial habitat diversity.
soil_moisture.reference: IPCC AR6 WG2, Chapter 3: Terrestrial and Freshwater Ecosystems (2022)

rainfall.description: Rainfall variability is the dominant climate driver of species survival in semi-arid agro-ecosystems, more so than mean temperature.
rainfall.reference: IPCC AR6 WG1, Chapter 8: Water Cycle Changes (2021)

temperature.description: Sustained temperatures above regional heat-stress thresholds reduce pollinator activity windows and accelerate soil organic carbon decomposition.
temperature.reference: IPBES Global Assessment Report on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services (2019)

land_use_type.description: Land use structure determines habitat heterogeneity; monocultures reduce structural complexity and fragment habitat corridors relative to intercropped or agroforestry systems.
land_use_type.reference: Newbold et al., Global effects of land use on local terrestrial biodiversity, Nature (2015)

habitat_fragmentation.description: Fragmentation index derived from patch size and connectivity; higher fragmentation isolates populations and reduces effective breeding ranges.
habitat_fragmentation.reference: Haddad et al., Habitat fragmentation and its lasting impact on Earth's ecosystems, Science Advances (2015)

species_richness.description: Number of distinct species observed in a defined area; the primary biodiversity outcome metric this system optimizes for.

pollinator_diversity.description: Diversity of pollinating insects and birds; a leading indicator of ecosystem resilience and crop yield stability.
pollinator_diversity.reference: Potts et al., Global pollinator declines: trends, impacts and drivers, Trends in Ecology & Evolution (2010)

pollution_load.description: Aggregate exposure to agrochemical runoff, industrial effluent, and airborne pollutants; suppresses soil microbial diversity and pollinator survival.
pollution_load.reference: IPBES-IPCC Co-Sponsored Workshop Report on Biodiversity and Climate Change (2021)

deforestation_rate.description: Annual rate of forest cover loss in the surrounding landscape; a leading driver of habitat fragmentation and regional microclimate shifts.
